reviewType: Read-only source and interface review; no process/browser execution
checks: Exact ordered 11/9/1 phase job contracts, complete/exit/binding/provider closure fields and child digest validation match the Node aggregate.
Previously exited managed-root PID is refused before and after pidfd registration; full identity and held pidfd are checked before signaling.
Managed root is reaped only by Popen; registered descendants are retained through owned cleanup, and observation bound failure cannot disable cleanup.
Deferred cancellation spans spawn registration; finalization cancellation revokes success through receipt publication.
Child elapsed deadline is checked after the final poll as well as while running; final elapsed budget remains bounded separately.
Private TMP identity, non-symlink canonical path and0700 mode are revalidated during execution; source and capture/tool pins are rechecked.
Overflow logs, nonzero exit, timeout, forced cleanup, residual owned processes, validation drift and incomplete phase results cannot qualify.
Workflow uses mandatory Linux guard invocation before capture; portable local results do not establish Linux pidfd/subreaper execution.
limits: This review does not execute the9 Linux lifetime guards, any browser, a build, or a hosted workflow.
Synchronous filesystem reads can delay polling; final elapsed validation rejects late success, as documented by the supervisor.
No physical-device, audible, unfamiliar-player or additional endurance result is implied.
